votes.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Power' AND ha.attribute_value >= 90
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY power_count DESC

WITH strength_data AS (

         s.superhero_name,
         s.height_cm,
         s.alignment_id,
         ha.attribute_value AS strength
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'

  SELECT alignment_id, AVG(strength) AS avg_strength
  FROM strength_data
  GROUP BY alignment_id

  SELECT sd.hero_id, sd.superhero_name, sd.height_cm

  JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
),
top_powers AS (

WITH attr_sum AS (
        SELECT hero_id, SUM(attribute_value) AS total_attribute
        FROM hero_attribute
        GROUP BY hero_id
    ),
    power_cnt AS (
        SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
        FROM hero_power
        GROUP BY hero_id
    )
SELECT
    s.superhero_name,
    p.publisher_name,
    COALESCE(a.total_attribute, 0) AS total_attribute,
    COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0) AS power_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.publisher_name
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(a.total_attribute, 0) + COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0)) DESC
    ) AS rank_in_publisher
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN attr_sum a ON s.id = a.hero_id
LEFT JOIN power_cnt pc ON s.id = pc.hero_id
WHERE COALESCE(a.total_attribute, 0) >= 200
  AND COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0) >= 3
ORDER BY p.publisher_name, rank_in_publisher;

WITH hero_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id,
        s.superhero_name,
        s.publisher_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ha.attribute_id) AS attribute_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero s
    LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.publisher_id
),
publisher_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        superhero_name,
        publisher_id,
        (attribute_count + power_count) AS total_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY publisher_id ORDER BY (attribute_count + power_count) DESC) AS rank_within_publisher
    FROM hero_stats
)
SELECT 
    superhero_name
FROM publisher_ranked
ORDER BY rank_within_publisher ASC;

WITH attr_sum AS (
    SELECT hero_id, SUM(attribute_value) AS attr_total
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
power_cnt AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_total
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
scores AS (
    SELECT s.id,
           s.superhero_name,
           s.publisher_id,
           COALESCE(a.attr_total, 0) + COALESCE(p.power_total, 0) AS total_score
    FROM superhero s
    LEFT JOIN attr_sum a ON s.id = a.hero_id
    LEFT JOIN power_cnt p ON s.id = p.hero_id
),
avg_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_tot FROM scores
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores, avg_score
    WHERE total_score >= avg_tot
)
SELECT superhero_name,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY publisher_id ORDER BY total_score DESC) AS rank
FROM filtered
ORDER BY publisher_id, rank;

SELECT superhero_name,
       CASE 
           WHEN total_score >= 200 THEN 'A-Class'
           WHEN total_score >= 100 THEN 'B-Class'
       END AS class
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, SUM(ha.attribute_value) AS total_score
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.id
) t
WHERE total_score >= 100;

WITH strength_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id,
           s.superhero_name,
           s.alignment_id,
           ha.attribute_value,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.alignment_id ORDER BY ha.attribute_value) AS pr
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM strength_heroes
    WHERE pr > 0.75
),
avg_height_per_alignment AS (
    SELECT s.alignment_id,
           AVG(s.height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
    FROM qualified q
    JOIN superhero s ON s.id = q.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.alignment_id
),
power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT al.alignment,
       (CAST(avg_h.avg_height_cm / 30.48 AS INTEGER) || ' ft ' ||
        ROUND((avg_h.avg_height_cm / 2.54) % 12) || ' in') AS avg_height,
       s.superhero_name,
       pc.power_count
FROM qualified q
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = q.hero_id
JOIN alignment al ON al.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN avg_height_per_alignment avg_h ON avg_h.alignment_id = s.alignment_id
LEFT JOIN power_counts pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
ORDER BY al.alignment, s.superhero_name;

WITH strength_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id as hero_id,
        s.alignment_id,
        al.alignment,
        s.height_cm,
        ha.attribute_value as strength_value
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment al ON s.alignment_id = al.id
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    JOIN attribute attr ON ha.attribute_id = attr.id
    WHERE attr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
pct_threshold AS (
    SELECT 
        alignment_id,
        strength_value,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strength_data sd2 
         WHERE sd2.alignment_id = strength_data.alignment_id) as total_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strength_data sd3 
         WHERE sd3.alignment_id = strength_data.alignment_id 
         AND sd3.strength_value > strength_data.strength_value) as better_than_count
    FROM strength_data
),
qualifying_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pt.hero_id,
        pt.alignment_id,
        pt.alignment,
        pt.height_cm,
        pt.strength_value
    FROM strength_data pt
    JOIN pct_threshold pt2 ON pt.hero_id = pt2.hero_id
    WHERE CAST(pt2.better_than_count AS REAL) / pt2.total_count < 0.25
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) as power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT 
    qh.alignment,
    ROUND(AVG(qh.height_cm * 0.0328084), 2) as avg_height_ft,
    (SELECT SUM(hpc.power_count) 
     FROM hero_power_counts hpc 
     WHERE hpc.hero_id IN (
         SELECT hero_id FROM qualifying_heroes qh2 
         WHERE qh2.alignment_id = qh.alignment_id
     )) as total_superpowers
FROM qualifying_heroes qh
GROUP BY qh.alignment;

WITH strength_data AS (
    SELECT s.id AS hero_id,
           s.alignment_id,
           ha.attribute_value AS strength,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.alignment_id ORDER BY ha.attribute_value) AS pct_rank
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
filtered_heroes AS (
    SELECT hero_id, alignment_id
    FROM strength_data
    WHERE pct_rank > 0.75
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_cnt
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
hero_stats AS (
    SELECT fh.hero_id,
           fh.alignment_id,
           s.height_cm,
           COALESCE(hpc.power_cnt, 0) AS power_cnt
    FROM filtered_heroes fh
    JOIN superhero s ON fh.hero_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power_counts hpc ON fh.hero_id = hpc.hero_id
)
